rows.proof: `FY 2021 RECEIPTS - JUNE 2021`, PDF page 25 of the FY2021 annual town report (printed folio 24), a LANDSCAPE page, mediaBox 792x612. READ, NOT RECOGNISED: pdfplumber returns 0 words on this page. The page prints 100 figures in three free-form label/amount column pairs and no column header at all -- a banner and then the lines -- so there is nothing to NAME (rule 13b.4). What it does print is its own `SUMMARY OF RECEIPTS` block of nine category lines and a `GRAND TOTAL` of $44,252,049.61, and that is what every figure here is proved against. TWO INDEPENDENT ASSERTIONS, BOTH TO THE CENT: all 100 detail lines add to $44,252,049.61 (this file), and the nine printed summary lines add to the same figure (`fy2021-p25-receipts-summary.csv`). SIX OF THE NINE CATEGORIES ARE FOOTED SEPARATELY HERE, and the category of each line is taken from the heading the page prints above it -- `LICENSES/PERMITS:`, `STATE REVENUE:`, `FINES & FORFEITS:`, `EARNINGS ON INVESTMENTS:`, the standalone `TRANSFERS FROM OTHER FUNDS` line, and the four-line unheaded block (TRAILER PARKS, RESCUE WAGON, MEADOW WOODS WATER PRINCIPAL and INTEREST) of which three foot exactly to the printed SPECIAL ASSESSMENTS. WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: the page prints no heading that separates TAXES & EXCISES from FEES from NON RECURRING REVENUE, so the remaining 60 lines are footed as ONE column against the sum of those three printed summary figures and are NOT split between them here. A residual does fit -- the 14 lines under TAXES & EXCISES/INTEREST/DEMANDS plus PRIOR YEAR EXCISE and PRIOR YEAR INT/DEMAND, LESS SUPPL TAX-NEW CONSTRUCTION ($66,374.46), is $31,200,742.70 to the cent -- but that is arithmetic choosing a grouping, not the document stating one, and several other partitions fit the same three totals. Rule 7: it is recorded as a hypothesis and is not used. NOT BLOCKED, AND DELIBERATELY CHECKED AGAINST FY2023 p25, WHICH IS: this is the same table family, and the FY2023 page is hard blocked for being unreadable at any magnification. This one is not. The FY2021 page carries its table at a resolution where every digit is separable at 6x -- $27,884,944.92, $7,773,938.00 and $104.47 all read cleanly -- which is why it closes to the cent and FY2023's could not be attempted.

rows.proof: `FY 2021 RECEIPTS - JUNE 2021`, PDF page 25 of the FY2021 annual town report (printed folio 24), a LANDSCAPE page, mediaBox 792x612. READ, NOT RECOGNISED: pdfplumber returns 0 words on this page. The page prints 100 figures in three free-form label/amount column pairs and no column header at all -- a banner and then the lines -- so there is nothing to NAME (rule 13b.4). What it does print is its own `SUMMARY OF RECEIPTS` block of nine category lines and a `GRAND TOTAL` of $44,252,049.61, and that is what every figure here is proved against. TWO INDEPENDENT ASSERTIONS, BOTH TO THE CENT: all 100 detail lines add to $44,252,049.61 (this file), and the nine printed summary lines add to the same figure (`fy2021-p25-receipts-summary.csv`). SIX OF THE NINE CATEGORIES ARE FOOTED SEPARATELY HERE, and the category of each line is taken from the heading the page prints above it -- `LICENSES/PERMITS:`, `STATE REVENUE:`, `FINES & FORFEITS:`, `EARNINGS ON INVESTMENTS:`, the standalone `TRANSFERS FROM OTHER FUNDS` line, and the four-line unheaded block (TRAILER PARKS, RESCUE WAGON, MEADOW WOODS WATER PRINCIPAL and INTEREST) of which three foot exactly to the printed SPECIAL ASSESSMENTS. WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: the page prints no heading that separates TAXES & EXCISES from FEES from NON RECURRING REVENUE, so the remaining 60 lines are footed as ONE column against the sum of those three printed summary figures and are NOT split between them here. A residual does fit -- the 14 lines under TAXES & EXCISES/INTEREST/DEMANDS plus PRIOR YEAR EXCISE and PRIOR YEAR INT/DEMAND, LESS SUPPL TAX-NEW CONSTRUCTION ($66,374.46), is $31,200,742.70 to the cent -- but that is arithmetic choosing a grouping, not the document stating one, and several other partitions fit the same three totals. Rule 7: it is recorded as a hypothesis and is not used. NOT BLOCKED, AND DELIBERATELY CHECKED AGAINST FY2023 p25, WHICH IS: this is the same table family, and the FY2023 page is hard blocked for being unreadable at any magnification. This one is not. The FY2021 page carries its table at a resolution where every digit is separable at 6x -- $27,884,944.92, $7,773,938.00 and $104.47 all read cleanly -- which is why it closes to the cent and FY2023's could not be attempted.

rows.proof: `GENERAL FUND APPROPRIATIONS -- SUMMARY & CLASSIFICATION OF ACCOUNTS, FISCAL YEAR 2021`, PDF pages 27-31 of the FY2021 annual town report (printed folios 26-30; the folio is one LESS than the PDF page, which is why the page-number row was not recognised as furniture and was summed as an appropriation). THIS FILE IS THE FIRST MONEY COLUMN ONLY, headed `APPROPRIATED FORWARD`: the page prints five, and the other four are not transcribed here. 166 detail lines. THE PAGE STATES THREE IDENTITIES ABOUT ITSELF AND ALL THREE CLOSE TO THE CENT: the printed GRAND TOTAL $44,155,534.50; the footer legend `fwd - forward from FY 2020` $838,486.09, which is the sum of the 24 lines marked `fwd`; and `srt - Salary Reserve Transfer` $1,297.60, the single line so marked. In addition all 53 department subtotals the page prints in this column close exactly on their own detail lines. A `fwd` line is a real line of the column -- the heading is APPROPRIATED *FORWARD* -- and each department's printed subtotal includes it, which is what establishes that rather than an assumption of ours. WHY IT WAS READ: the generic extract reconciled at -$505,563.01 and the causes were all ours, confirmed on the rendered page -- p27 `Payroll-Finance Director/Town Accountant` lost its $105,381.07 to a long label; p30 dropped the `fwd` lines `Park Department` $13,032.00, `Facilities & Grounds` $24,431.83, `Public Buildings` $4,500.00 and `School Encumbered Funds FY 20` $366,874.21 whole; and p28 gained $8,656.10 it does not print, from one line split in two at `Art 4, 11/28/17 STM Conecptual Design TCP`, another at Conservation Commission `Other Expenses`, and the page folio 27 read as a figure.
